summary: Real, new, attributable mechanism (deletes the gather launch and the wg_xs round trip rather than overlapping it; not a duplicate), but the payoff is ~1% on verify_32 (~0.2% headline), smaller than claimed, and the spec misses a fence.proxy.async that wgmma needs, so as written it can be wrong.
justification: Producer warps 1-3 idle after setmaxnreg.dec 40 (submission.py ~1314-1338). wg_gather_kernel is 3.8 us (0.9%) of 402.4 us at verify_32 (combo-toprow b395f5b6); ceiling ~-1.2% on bs=256 incl. the launch gap; bs=256 err_ns ~3.2 us. Weakest link: w13 row flat when B moves from 2 TMA boxes to hundreds-thousands of 16-byte cp.async by 96 threads at 40 regs; a 2% w13 regression erases the gain. Hoist sorted_ids loads per item; copy only nvalid rows. Correctness gaps: (1) fence.proxy.async.shared::cta between generic-proxy writes (cp.async, zero-fill) and wgmma reads; (2) warps 1-3 must run the item/stage loop and wait on empty barriers; (3) bound rows to nvalid / sorted_ids.numel(). Prior (missing): wg-pdl-gather-w13-w2-chain (different mechanism).
confounders: wg-pdl-gather-w13-w2-chain: same launch chain; read WG MODULE BUILT and wg_pdl lines before attributing.
combo-toprow / align-two-phase-port-from17: front end sets sorted_ids layout and bucket mix; check PATH CHOSEN / wg_align2 lines match.
Board best is the occ2 branch (wg2_kernel, 1.4021x), not master (1.3866x): a clean gain here cannot move the board.
interference: No companions: the gather row vanishing and wg_kernel<true> staying within ~1 us of 258 us is the readout.
rules_flags: Process conflict: the hypothesis says its first measurement is an okc check, never a scored submit; only scored submits remain today.
Correctness: add fence.proxy.async.shared::cta; run the prepare copy check repeatedly on N64/N128 buckets.
open_questions: Empty-barrier waits and full-barrier arrive counts for warps 1-3 with zero rows.
Interaction with queued producer-scale-expand (also wants warps 1-3).
